title: ZIP-level demographics and national benchmarks in the Census guide
intro: The Census demographics guide now documents all eleven ACS geography levels, explains ZIP-level data honestly, and shows how to benchmark against national averages.
summary: ZIP vs ZCTA explained, with the no-data case
outro: Four new geography levels, a worked benchmark, and a published update. Ready for review.

shots.say: The guide now lists all eleven geography levels. ZCTA, Division, Region and Nation are the new ones.
Those four are never picked automatically. You request them by name, and for now they are API-only.
And the change is announced. The new update entry leads with ZIP-level demographics.
